title: Sam-Il

symbol.name: Sam-Il
symbol.meaning: The independence movement of 1 March 1919 · ITF pattern 16 of 24

note.p: Sam-Il (three-one) is the date of the Korean independence movement that began across the country on 1 March 1919. The 33 movements stand for the 33 patriots who planned it. You start in close ready stance C at the centre of the cross facing D: a guarding block, double forearm block, knife-hand side block, twisting kick and punch toward D; reverse knife-hand wedging blocks in sitting stance, upset fingertip and double fist low punches and a double arc-hand block back toward C; reverse knife-hand and U-shape blocks, a sweeping kick, a jumping spin and a side kick toward B; an elbow strike, back elbow thrust, X-fist block, W-shape block and side kick toward A; palm blocks in rear foot stance; then upset, middle and high punches, a low kick and a twin fist vertical punch to finish.

footer: Move numbers follow the ITF Encyclopedia count (33 movements; the sweeping kick and the U-shape block of 16 are split into -1 and -2 here). The moves go back and forth through the centre of the cross, so the board shows them in order, read down the page in rows; the minimap shows roughly where each one is. Directions use the ITF letters: you start facing D, with B on your left and A on your right; AD and BC are diagonals. Finish by bringing the left foot back to the ready posture.

moves.desc: Stand at the centre facing D in close ready stance C.
Slide toward D into a right L-stance facing D (left foot forward, weight on the right leg). Forearm middle guarding block.
Move the right foot to D into a right walking stance. Right double forearm high block.
Move the left foot to D into a left walking stance. Right knife-hand high side block, the left palm on the back of the right forearm.
Right middle twisting kick toward A, the hands held where they were.
Lower the right foot toward D into a right walking stance. Right middle punch.
Move the right foot along the C–D line into a sitting stance facing B. Reverse knife-hand middle wedging block.
Pivoting on the right foot, turn into a left walking stance facing C. Right upset fingertip low thrust.
Pull the left foot back into a right L-stance facing C (left foot forward, weight on the right leg). Right outer forearm high outward block toward D and left forearm low block toward C, together.
Move the right foot to C into a sitting stance facing A. Reverse knife-hand middle wedging block.
Pull the right foot back into a left L-stance facing C (right foot forward, weight on the left leg). Right double fist low punch.
Move the left foot to C into a left walking stance. Double arc-hand high block toward BC, looking through the hands.
Move the right foot to C into a right walking stance. Left middle punch.
Move the right foot along the C–D line into a right L-stance facing D (left foot forward, weight on the right leg). Left double fist low punch.
Move the left foot to B into a right L-stance facing B (left foot forward, weight on the right leg). Reverse knife-hand high guarding block.
Slip the left foot forward into a left fixed stance facing B (left foot forward). U-shape block.
Right sweeping kick toward B with the side sole.
Lower the right foot toward B into a right fixed stance (right foot forward). U-shape block.
Jump and spin round counter-clockwise, landing on the same spot in a left L-stance facing B (right foot forward, weight on the left leg). Knife-hand middle guarding block.
Right middle side piercing kick toward B, forming a knife-hand guarding block.
Lower the right foot beside the left foot, then move the left foot to A into a left walking stance facing A. Right front elbow strike into the left palm.
Move the right foot to A, turning counter-clockwise into a left diagonal stance facing D. Left back elbow thrust toward C, the right palm on the left fist, the face turned to C.
Turn into a right walking stance facing AD. X-fist pressing block.
Stamp the left foot toward A into a sitting stance facing C. W-shape block.
Left middle side piercing kick toward A, forming a forearm guarding block.
Lower the left foot on the line toward A, then pivoting on the left foot turn into a left L-stance facing B (right foot forward, weight on the left leg). Knife-hand low guarding block.
Move the left foot to B into a right rear foot stance facing B (left foot forward on its ball). Left palm upward block.
Move the right foot to B into a left rear foot stance facing B (right foot forward on its ball). Twin palm pressing block.
Stamp the left foot toward C into a left walking stance facing C. Twin fist upset punch.
Move the right foot to C into a left L-stance facing C (right foot forward, weight on the left leg). Right forearm low block, the left fist pulled under the left armpit.
In the same stance, left middle punch, the right fist brought over the left shoulder.
Pivoting on the right foot, turn into a left walking stance facing D. Right forearm middle front block.
In the same stance, left high punch, straight on from 30.
Left low front snap kick toward D, the hands held where they were.
Lower the left foot toward D, then stamp the right foot forward toward D into a right walking stance. Twin fist high vertical punch.
